_about: SEO experiments on a small set of pages, judged against the rest after the review date (seo/ledger.md). build-pricing.js applies pricing-title-v2 only to these ids. Roll an experiment out site-wide only after the verdict and David's OK (seo/README.md rule 3).

pricing-title-v2.what: Title states the real entry price and whether a free plan exists (no 'Free Plan' claim for tools without one), shorter than 60 characters; description leads with the cheapest option; FAQ adds 'What is the cheapest <tool> plan?'.
pricing-title-v2.why: Pricing pages hold ~65% of impressions at ~0.03% CTR; the old title said 'Free Plan' on every page.
pricing-title-v2.metric: 28-day CTR and average position of these pages vs all other /pricing/ pages, before (2026-10-04..10-31) and after.
